% Each colour model xcolor offers, in a default document: what ends up in the PDF?
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{xcolor}
\pagestyle{empty}
\definecolor{mRGB}{rgb}{0.8,0.2,0.1}
\definecolor{mHTML}{HTML}{FF8800}
\definecolor{mGray}{gray}{0.4}
\definecolor{mcmy}{cmy}{0.1,0.6,0.9}
\definecolor{mhsb}{hsb}{0.6,0.8,0.7}
\definecolor{mwave}{wave}{550}
\definecolor{mcmyk}{cmyk}{0.2,0.7,0.9,0.1}
\begin{document}
\textcolor{mRGB}{rgb} \textcolor{mHTML}{HTML} \textcolor{mGray}{gray} \textcolor{mcmy}{cmy}
\textcolor{mhsb}{hsb} \textcolor{mwave}{wave} \textcolor{mcmyk}{cmyk}
\end{document}
